title: 23rd Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/23/2/2025).
First reading of the Zakat Bill submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
Report of the Economic Committee on its review of the Maldives Intellectual Property Office Bill.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on the special audit report (2018-2020) on diesel purchase transactions for Maldives Ports Limited operations.
Report of the Environment and Climate Change Committee on the Bill amending the Water and Sewerage Act (Law No. 8/2020).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced the Zakat Bill and took up committee reports on the Intellectual Property Office Bill, an MPL diesel-purchase audit, and the Water and Sewerage Act amendment.
